evidence.text: The file page identifies this as a modern vector drawing of 好 in Shang oracle-script style, based on the J26184 form cited from hanziyuan. The page gives a reuse statement referring to permission from Richard Sears and separately describes the SVG representation as public domain. This is a redraw, not a photograph of an inscribed object.

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 好 oracle.svg 好 bronze.svg
search_audit.outcome: Search returned the 好 oracle file and links to the associated bronze and seal candidates. Opened all three source pages and inspected their descriptions, source identifiers, redraw status, and licensing statements.

search_audit.query: 好 oracle bone bronze glyph image Commons file
search_audit.outcome: Search results included unrelated character images and the 好 oracle drawing; unrelated results were excluded.

search_audit.query: Opened Wikimedia Commons pages and followed each page’s Original file link
search_audit.outcome: The Commons pages exposed the actual direct image links and resolved paths. Following those links in the browser failed because SVG content was unsupported (oracle and seal) or returned an internal fetch error (bronze). The file pages themselves were inspected, so source-page identity and licensing descriptions are recorded; actual image pixels were not inspected.

gaps: The browser could not retrieve the SVG files as viewable image content. The file pages identify them as 好 glyph redraws and state their provenance and reuse terms, but the glyph pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage. The harness should confirm downloaded assets before use.
The oracle, bronze, and seal files are modern vector redrawings, not photographs of Shang artifacts or excavated objects.
The source pages describe the drawings as based on hanziyuan records J26184, B17049, and S09198; those underlying hanziyuan records were not independently opened in this invocation.

items.period: Shang period (as labeled by the source page: Shang oracle script style)
items.caption: A modern redraw labeled as Shang oracle-script 好; the file page identifies its model as hanziyuan form J26184.
items.alt: Black vector outline of an early-script glyph, presented by its source page as 好 in Shang oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides an early graphic candidate relevant to the reported 女-plus-子 analysis; source page supplies the form label and provenance. Visual pixels remain to be checked by the harness.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons file page states public-domain status for the SVG representation and also reports permission from Richard Sears; retain attribution/provenance as shown on the file page.

limitations.text: Direct SVG retrieval through the browser failed, so candidate glyphs were selected from inspected source-page descriptions and the harness must validate the downloaded pixels. Do not treat these as inspected or photographed ancient artifacts.
